comments.value: FBO-IFC mapping release 2026.09.04 (issued 2026-09-04). The official alignment module. Each named individual describes how an FBO term is expressed in IFC 4.3: IFC class and predefined type, property set and property, data type, expected value and whether it is a buildingSMART standard property.
